body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Schedules calibrations and preventive maintenance before equipment drifts out of tolerance. A calibration and maintenance scheduler tracks due dates, usage hours, and calibration intervals for every instrument, schedules work orders, and quarantines overdue equipment. Real implementations include GAGEtrak, IndySoft, and open CMMS tools. It adjusts intervals from as-found/as-left history and keeps the audit trail inspectors expect.

Interval adjustment from historical drift data

body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Calibration and Maintenance Scheduler, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Calibration due tracking by date, usage, or events). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Calibration due tracking by date, usage, or events and Work-order generation and technician assignment. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Calibration traceability database) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
